tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Window background: behind the toolbar and every panel.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panel fill: the queue list, the log panel, the settings strip, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Row fill on hover or selection inside a panel; the fill of input-like controls at rest.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Track background for the slider and the progress bar; a disabled control's fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline: panel edges, the divider between queue rows, table rules. Decorative only — never the sole signal of meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Resting outline on buttons and input fields. Decorative strength only; a state or focus that must read on its own uses accent-strong, success, danger or muted instead, which hold 3:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-100 or surface-200: field labels, helper text, log timestamps, the byline under a queue row's filename.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled control labels only, on surface-200 or surface-300 — never body copy or a status word.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions (Boshlash), the slider's filled track and thumb, the checked state of a toggle, the ‘ishlanmoqda’ status text and progress fill, as text on surface-100/200 or on accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for an accent fill or accent text; the keyboard focus ring (see the focus-ring shadow token) on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Background tint behind accent text: the ‘ishlanmoqda’ (processing) status pill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid accent or accent-strong fill — the label on the primary button, never plain white or black.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The ‘tayyor’ (done) status text, icon and border, as text on surface-200 or on success-subtle.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background tint behind success text: the done status pill.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a solid success fill, if one is ever used (e.g. a success toast).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The ‘xato’ (error) status text, icon and border; a blocking doctor() failure; destructive intent, as text on surface-200 or on danger-subtle.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background tint behind danger text: the error status pill and the blocking doctor() banner.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid danger fill — a destructive button's label, if one is added.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: The ‘navbatda’ (queued) and ‘toʻxtatildi’ (stopped) status text and icon, as text on surface-200 or on muted-subtle. A cool grey, kept apart from ink-tertiary so a status pill never reads as merely faded text.

tokens.name: muted-subtle
tokens.usage: Background tint behind muted text: the queued and stopped status pills.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Segoe UI ships with Windows 10/11, the app's only supported OS — no font files travel in the portable package.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The cover and the About panel only — never inside the working window.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: filenames, buttons, menu items, dialog copy.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text: the status word inside a pill, a dialog's default action.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and slider labels, the toolbar's small captions above a control.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and metadata under a row, the doctor banner's fine print, footnotes.

groups.name: Numeric
groups.note: Tabular figures for anything that updates in place, so digits don't jitter frame to frame.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Live counters in the progress row: frame count, kadr/s, qolgan vaqt.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The scrolling log panel, and CLI examples in component guidelines.

spacing.note: 4px base grid, dense enough for a desktop utility window.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; a chip's vertical inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside a compact control: button, chip, badge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Internal padding of a queue row; gap between a row's cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between toolbar groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between major panels, e.g. the queue and the log.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer window margin; space around the cover's title block.

radius.note: Small and consistent — a tool window, not a marketing surface.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, checkboxes, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, input fields, queue rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, the log console, the preview window frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills and the slider thumb.

shadow.note: Used sparingly: this is a flat, native-feeling tool, not a card-and-shadow web app.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: The preview window and any modal dialog, floated above the main window.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px surface-100-colour gap, then a solid 2px accent-strong ring, so it follows each control's own radius.
